import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))

# Plot 1: Distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
sns.histplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud', multiple='stack', bins=30, ax=ax[0], palette='coolwarm')
ax[0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status')
ax[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount')
ax[0].set_ylabel('Count')
ax[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Plot 2: Count of transactions by type and fraud status
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', ax=ax[1], palette='coolwarm')
ax[1].set_title('Transaction Type Count by Fraud Status')
ax[1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax[1].set_ylabel('Count')
ax[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))

# Plot 1: Distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
sns.histplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud', multiple='stack', bins=30, ax=ax[0], palette='coolwarm')
ax[0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status')
ax[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount')
ax[0].set_ylabel('Count')
ax[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Plot 2: Count of transactions by type and fraud status
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', ax=ax[1], palette='coolwarm')
ax[1].set_title('Transaction Type Count by Fraud Status')
ax[1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax[1].set_ylabel('Count')
ax[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
